Broken JSON-LD Must Not Crash

The ld+json block above has trailing commas after the author name and after the author object, which is invalid JSON (real-world CMS templating bugs produce exactly this). A valid article:published_time meta tag (2019-11-11) is also present as a fallback. This probes that a JSON parse failure is caught and does not crash extraction, and that the extractor still falls back to the meta tag instead of losing the date entirely.
